thread:
Maya Patel: Anyone seeing client reconnects for our SSE endpoints correlated with very small chunked frames? Console shows a bunch of new sessions + billing bump.
Trevor Kim: Yep. Spike started after the chunked encoder rollout yesterday. Small bodies get split, client does per-chunk JSON.parse and throws -> reconnect.
Lucy Ng: @Trevor can you paste a raw example from the proxy logs? is it just LF/RF boundary behavior?
Trevor Kim: Grabbed a snippet from the proxy stream slices: 
```text
{"id":123,"msg":"start"
}
{"id":124,"msg":"cont"}
```
Client-side parser sees `{"id":123,"msg":"start"` and fails until next chunk, we end up reconnecting.
Ian Cho: Hmm. Client should stream-parse or buffer, but we shouldn't emit partial JSON tokens. Two levers: (1) proxy/router coalesce small chunks up to N bytes or until a delimiter, (2) client lib buffers until full JSON or a safe delimiter.
Maya Patel: Right now some routes are configured to flush aggressively to hit latency SLOs. That aggressive flush introduced this regression.
Lucy Ng: If proxy coalesces, we'll add ~5-12ms median. For latency-sensitive tenants that's nontrivial. Could be a tenant-tier policy.
Trevor Kim: Console/telemetry is worse — every reconnect is a new session row, so active session count and billing estimates spike. We should dedupe reconnects when resume token or same traceid present.
sre-bot: Alert: 7223456789 - SSE reconnect rate +23% in us-west-2 since 04:12 UTC.
Maya Patel: Proposal: (a) hotfix: enable proxy coalesce global for 24h to stop churn, (b) client quick patch to buffer up to 200ms or until `\n\n` delimiter, (c) console: treat reconnects with same resume token as same session within a 5s window for metrics/billing.
Ian Cho: Fine with plan but prefer coalesce be routing-configurable. Make coalesce a per-route flag and default to on for lower tiers. Also add a kernel-level small-batch path in serving runtime later.
Lucy Ng: Rollout: canary coalesce on 10% traffic -> measure p95 latency and reconnect rate. Console change should surface `reconnect_dedupe_rate` so we can see before/after.
Maya Patel: I'll open PRs for the proxy and client. Can someone own the console metric + panel? @Lucy? :slightly_smiling_face:
Lucy Ng: I'll take console. I'll add a derived metric `reconnect_dedupe_rate` and update the session panel and billing preview chart.
Trevor Kim: I'll own proxy change and run canary. Will add a flag `sse.coalesce_bytes=256` default in canary.
Ian Cho: I'll coordinate client patch with FE. Will push a minor lib release and note in release notes.
Maya Patel: Adding a short support playbook blurb: "If you see sudden SSE reconnect burst, check chunked-encoder rollout, flip proxy.coalesce toggle for the tenant, and watch `reconnect_dedupe_rate`." :memo:
Trevor Kim: One more ask: console should surface a small histogram of chunk sizes leading to reconnects so we can prove the cause.
Lucy Ng: Good idea. I'll add a panel pulling `proxy.chunk_size` sampling on reconnects.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. If canary looks good we'll keep coalesce on for 72h and then make routing-config default change.
Ian Cho: FYI I'll coordinate with FE to ship client patch by EOD tomorrow.
Trevor Kim: Starting proxy PR now.
Maya Patel: I'll post rollout checklist in #release-war-room when PRs merge.
